The Biathlon World Cup season continues with the Women's 15km Individual race in Kontiolahti, Finland on Friday, 27 November 2026. The competition is scheduled to start at 15:15 GMT. Kontiolahti's biathlon stadium hosts the event, which forms part of the early-season World Cup calendar. The individual discipline rewards shooting precision over raw speed, with each missed target adding a one-minute penalty to the skier's time.

This race marks the first individual-format competition for the women's field at this venue during the 2026–27 World Cup season. The Kontiolahti course is known for its demanding roller-coaster profile and a shooting range that can be exposed to shifting winds. Athletes who combine clean shooting with consistent ski speed typically rise to the top of the standings.

World Cup points awarded here count equally toward the overall Individual discipline cup and the Total Score standings.
